sections.title: Recorded history
sections.sql: select actor,action,details,created_at from activity where kind='capas' and record_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Inspections
sections.sql: select code,batch,inspected_on,result,inspector,evidence from inspections where supplier_id=$1 order by inspected_on

sections.title: Corrective actions
sections.sql: select code,title,status,due_on,verification from capas where supplier_id=$1 order by due_on

sections.title: Completion and evidence
sections.sql: select t.code,t.person,d.code as document,t.revision,d.revision as current_revision,t.due_on,t.completed_on,t.evidence from training t join documents d on d.id=t.document_id where t.id=$1
